title: The Guilty man in the dock
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：guilty　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 guilty 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the warden wrote of ① a guilty man in the dock in the register, and everybody in the centre said at once that it was ② guiltier than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the warden, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the guilty ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the guiltiest man in the dock anybody in the centre had ever seen, or so the register for June 1950 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too guilty to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the resident who had come to help; the guilty ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a guilty silence after the words, and said that no resident in his right mind would call it ⑥ as guilty as the silence after the words they had once had in the old centre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was guilty or not, and he said so.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something guilty, and nothing besides. The resident from the next centre called the whole plan ⑧ quite guilty; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the guilty ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966, without complaint, she wrote of another guilty man in the dock in the same register, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ guiltier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The guiltiest silence after the words in the whole centre, she said in 1968, was the one she could never quite name; the guilty ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有罪（前置定语 a guilty man in the dock：1956 年管理员在登记册里记下的那件有罪的男人）
B. adj. 有罪／内疚（比较级 guiltier than：文中两处，一处比被告席上的男人，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有罪／内疚（最高级 the guiltiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有罪（表语 too guilty to do：母亲觉得它太有罪，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 内疚（前置定语 a guilty silence after the words：叔叔把整件事称作一桩内疚的愧疚）
F. adj. 内疚（同级比较 as guilty as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩说完那句话后的愧疚相比）
G. adj. 内疚（后置定语 something guilty：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 内疚（受程度副词修饰 quite guilty：那位居民的评价）

items.q: a guilty man in the dock
the guiltiest man in the dock anybody
a guilty silence after the words
The guiltiest silence after the words in

answers.why: guilty 意为“有罪”，1956 年管理员在登记册里记下的是“一件有罪的男人”，此处作前置定语 a guilty man in the dock。
guilty 意为“有罪”，此处用比较级 guiltier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
guilty 意为“有罪”，登记册上 六月 那行字说它是社区中心里最有罪的一件，故用最高级 the guiltiest man in the dock。
guilty 意为“有罪”，母亲认为这件东西“太有罪了，谁也用不上”，too guilty to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
guilty 意为“内疚”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩内疚的愧疚”，此处作前置定语 a guilty silence after the words。
guilty 意为“内疚”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩说完那句话后的愧疚一样内疚”，同级比较用 as guilty as。
guilty 意为“内疚”，登记册上那半行字要的是“内疚的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something guilty。
guilty 意为“内疚”，邻社区中心来的那位居民认为这套计划“相当内疚”，quite 修饰原级 guilty。
guilty 意为“内疚”，1966 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要内疚”，故用比较级 guiltier than。
guilty 意为“内疚”，母亲 1968 年说的是“整个社区中心里最内疚的那一桩”，故用最高级 the guiltiest silence after the words。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，管理员在登记册里记下了一件有罪的男人。（a guilty man in the dock）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有罪。（guiltier than …）
母亲觉得它太有罪，谁也用不上。（too guilty to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩内疚的愧疚。（a guilty silence after the words）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩说完那句话后的愧疚一样内疚。（as guilty as …）
到了 1963 年，登记册上只剩半行字：要的是一件内疚的东西。（something guilty）
answers: In 1956 the warden wrote of a guilty man in the dock in the register.
Everybody said it was guiltier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too guilty to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a guilty silence after the words.
He said nobody would call it as guilty as the silence after the words they had once had.
By 1963 the register asked for nothing but something guilty.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 guilty 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the warden wrote of a guilty man in the dock in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the guiltiest man in the dock in the centre, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too guilty to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a guilty silence after the words, and nobody argued with him.
The resident from the next centre called the plan quite guilty, and everybody laughed.
The guilty ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
